title: MATE: Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution for Safe and Efficient Mobile Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.25526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile agents on personal smartphones can affect private data, payments, settings, and the foreground screen. We present MATE (Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution), an execution-layer system that controls the boundary between agent action proposals and device effects without modifying the underlying model. MATE represents each UI primitive as a structured action record that combines the instruction, target app, screen context, primitive, and action fields. Runtime Guardrail (RG) maps this record to an allow, block, or user-approval decision; Predefined Task Routing (PTR) serves recurring requests through verified routes with post-execution screen checks; and a floating interface keeps execution in a compact overlay. On MobileSafetyBench, MATE raises high-risk blocking from 29.7% to 97.0% under GPT-4o. On AndroidWorld, it reduces LLM calls by up to 6x and raises recurring-use task success to 95.7%.

translated_title: MATE：面向安全高效移动控制的移动智能体可信执行
translated_abstract: 个人智能手机上的移动智能体可能会影响私密数据、支付、设置以及前台屏幕。我们提出了MATE（移动智能体可信执行），这是一个执行层系统，无需修改底层模型即可控制智能体动作提议与设备实际效果之间的边界。MATE将每个UI原语表示为结构化动作记录，该记录结合了指令、目标应用、屏幕上下文、原语和动作等字段。运行时护栏（RG）将该记录映射为允许、阻止或需用户批准的决策；预定义任务路由（PTR）通过经过验证的路径及执行后的屏幕检查来处理重复性请求；而浮动界面则使执行保持在紧凑的悬浮层中。在MobileSafetyBench上，MATE在使用GPT-4o时将高风险行为拦截率从29.7%提升至97.0%。在AndroidWorld上，它将LLM调用次数最多减少6倍，并将重复使用任务的成功率提升至95.7%。
tldr: MATE是一个无需修改底层模型的执行层系统，通过结构化动作记录、运行时护栏、预定义任务路由和浮动界面，将移动智能体高风险行为拦截率从29.7%提升至97.0%，同时减少最多6倍的LLM调用并将重复任务成功率提升至95.7%。
en_tdlr: MATE is an execution-layer system that controls mobile agent actions without modifying the underlying model, raising high-risk blocking from 29.7% to 97.0% on MobileSafetyBench while reducing LLM calls by up to 6x and achieving 95.7% success on recurring tasks on AndroidWorld.
